en:
"Gyahahahaha!
Now you're talkin', hey!"{w}{p}"Here it comes, here it comes -- Joker Land's famous specialty!{w}Poison-poisoooon FLAAAAASH!!"{w}
note: Clown doll; the player just picked the poison option. 'dokudoku~ furaaaashu' is the stretched-out name of the menu choice in slice_011 row 935 (dokudoku flash); English assumes that choice reads 'Poison-Poison Flash' -- sync with slice_011.

en:
"Gyahahaha!
Serves you right! Hee hee hee!!"{w}{p}"..........{w}Y'know what? I'm bored of playing with these guys.{w}...Guess I'll just kill 'em."{w}
note: Sudden mood drop is in the source (long silence, then 'korosu ka'); kept at full force.

en: There is an open space here.{w}
Use the Strange Box Garden?
note: Item name 'fushigi na hakoniwa' (key item, ITEM_PRIZ 62, max 18 chars): 'Strange Box Garden' = 18. 'fushigi na' -> 'Strange' as in wmap (Strange Bookmark, Strange Voice).

en: Dungeon Load data created successfully.{w}
note: System/op096 message. Read 'dungeon roodo' as 'load' (data being generated); could also be 'road'. Unverified in game.

en: Failed to create Dungeon Load data.{w}
note: See row 940.

en: There are marks where something used to be placed.{w}
note: Source writes 'ato' with the kanji for 'after' -- a typo for 'trace/mark'.

en: "Ah, Makakuri...{w}Look."{w}
note: Speaker box is '??' (row 943) -- it is Lu, not yet introduced. Lu's lines are written in odd katakana-mixed script (an unnatural, stilted voice); English renders this as plain, contraction-free, slightly stiff speech rather than mangled spelling.

en: Makakuri
note: New name (MON_TEXT 368: Hilde's demon follower, once a skeleton, now has a flesh body).

en: "Adventurers, huh... Your kind's never given me{w}a single good memory.{w}Get lost... And Ruu, don't bother with the likes of them."{w}
Ruu
note: New name (small-u 'Ruu'); romanized 'Lu'.

en: "...Do you travel to many different places?"{w}
note: Lu to the party.

en: "Hey, Ruu! We're going!"{w}
"Okay..."{w}

note: Start of the second meeting.

en:
"...What do you lot want?{w}Like I told you before, you adventurers've never given me
a single good..."{w}
note: Trails off in the source; kept unfinished.

en: "...Hey, Ruu?"{w}
"Are you searching for something too?"{w}
note: 'mo' = 'you too' -- Lu and Makakuri are also searching.

en: "Hey, Ruu!"{w}
"But we cannot find it by ourselves.{w}We have searched for so long, and still we have not found it."{w}
note: 'it' = their sagashimono (what they are looking for); it turns out to be a girl (row 962), but Lu has not said so yet.

en: "That doesn't mean we have to..."{w}
note: Cut off; Makakuri objects to asking adventurers for help.

en: "...Makakuri."{w}
"...Oh, fine, I get it already! Do what you want!{w}But if it comes down to it, I'm running, you hear!?"{w}
"But I know you will not run.{w}That is why I like you, Makakuri."{w}
"Shut up!"{w}
"If you find a short girl with blue hair,{w}please tell us.{w}We are looking for her."{w}
note: 'her' is safe: the source says onna no ko (girl).

en: "That's the deal! Got it?{w}...Jeez, why're we asking adventurers, of all people..."{w}
note: 'nandatte boukensha nanzo ni...' -- object of the sentence is implied (asking/relying on); restored as 'asking'.

en: "A short brat with blue hair!{w}Don't you forget it, got that!?"{w}
note: 'gaki' = brat; kept rude, which is what Lu objects to next.

en: "Makakuri, that is a rude way to say it."{w}
"Butt out!"{w}
note: 'hottoke' -- same English in row 976.

en:
You told them about the girl you had met
in the Crystal Labyrinth.{w}
note: 'Crystal Labyrinth' as in wmap slice_06 rows 468/470.

en: "The Crystal Labyrinth, huh..."{w}
"Thank you."{w}

"...I really don't get you adventurers."{w}{p}"Why would you go out of your way
to help the likes of us..."{w}
"Some people are good people, you know."{w}
note: Lu answers row 970: some adventurers are good people.

en: "If you say so."{w}
"Then we will go now.{w}Thank you. Truly."{w}
"Be nice to the undead, y'hear!"{w}
note: 'fushizoku' = the undead (as a race). Makakuri was formerly a skeleton (MON_TEXT 368), hence the parting shot; Lu calls it rude again.

en: "Makakuri... like I said, that is a rude way to say it."{w}
note: 'dakara' = 'I told you' -- callback to row 965.

en: "Butt out!"{w}
note: Same as row 966.

en:
There are many gravestones with no names on them.{w}{p}But no one seems to have tended them lately.
The graves have been dug up and ransacked, and bones lie scattered about.{w}
note: Nameless graveyard of Rust Temple's quest (wmap slice_07 row 558).

en:
There are many gravestones with no names on them.{w}{p}But no one seems to have tended them lately.
Weeds have sprung up all around, and bones dug up from the graves lie scattered about.{w}{p}From somewhere comes the growl of wild dogs.{w}It seems they are the ones ransacking the graves.{w}
note: 'yaken' = wild dogs, as in wmap slice_07 row 558; plural kept to match row 979. 'kono koe no nushi' (the owner of this voice) -> 'they'.

en: You drove off the wild dogs that were ransacking the graves.{w}
There are many gravestones with no names on them.{w}Looking closely, you see small letters carved into them.{w}

note: Grave inscription in an asterisk frame (not an echo of the previous row). Full-width padding replaced by ASCII spaces; 3-line frame kept.

en: "What do you want?{w}Come to take back your goods?{w}Too bad. I already sold off the whole lot."{w}{p}"Huh? This book? Couldn't get a price for it.{w}Read it to kill time, and it turned out to be pretty good."{w}{p}"So that's how it is. Go on home.{w}There's nothin' left for you to take ba-- What? This book, you say?{w}...Sorry, but this one I ain't givin' back. Hey, boys!"{w}
note: Thief who robbed Lotz's cargo (EVENT_TEXT 33, ITEM_PRIZ 55 'Lotz event'). 'Omaera ga torikaesu mon nanka...' is cut off by 'nani?'; rendered as an interruption.

en: "I give! I'm sorry! I'll give it back, I'll give it back!{w}Don't get so worked up over a book nobody'd even pay for!"{w}{p}"...But hey, you're takin' it back to its owner, right?{w}Um... about me comin' by to borrow it... if that'd be okay...{w}I'm in no position to ask, but... put in a word for me, would ya?"{w}
note: Page 2 is identical to row 985; same English. 'Karini ittemo... moshi dekiru nara... tanondoite kure' = ask the owner whether he may come borrow the book.

en:
[Key Item]
Obtained Mujirod Manuscript.{w}
note: New name 'Mujid' (romanized). 'shahon' = hand-copied manuscript. 18 chars, fits ITEM_PRIZ 55 (max 18).

en: "...But hey, you're takin' it back to its owner, right?{w}Um... about me comin' by to borrow it... if that'd be okay...{w}I'm in no position to ask, but... put in a word for me, would ya?"{w}
note: Identical to row 983 page 2.

en: You passed on Lotz's message.{w}
note: New name 'Lotz' (romanized): old goblin who runs a magic shop in Lumisthenes (MON_TEXT 347).

en:
"Really!? Thanks a ton!{w}Never figured I'd actually be welcome..."{w}{p}"...Right. It ain't much of a thank-you, but
use this. I prob'ly won't need it anymore."{w}
note: 'kangei sareru' -- Lotz's message evidently welcomes him to come read/borrow the book.

en: "Well, so long. Thanks a lot."{w}

note: Floor Master encounter (Crotoa NE). Knight's gender unknown: 'the knight's' / 'its bearing' (bearing of a mindless figure).

en: Threading through the rubble of the city streets, a lone knight appeared.{w}
note: Crotoa SE Floor Master.

en: Dark Lord
note: Monster/class name 'daakuroodo' (MONRAW/MONSTER2).

en:
Neither side said a word.{w}{p}Of course, adventurers are free to offer a greeting.{w}Free to doubt, free to accept,
and free to draw their swords, too...{w}
Bishop
note: Glossary: shikyou = Bishop.

en:
"...Same line of work, huh? How's business on your end?
Us? Haha, can't complain, I guess."{w}
note: 'go-dougyou' = fellow adventurers; 'keiki' (business/fortunes) kept as the joke.

en: Fighter
note: 'senshi' as the Wizardry-style class name; no precedent in the corpus.
'fundari kettari' = one misfortune after another.

en: "Don't say that. It might be worth somethin', y'know?"{w}

note: 'daijoobu' in katakana = breezy 'A-OK'.

en: "Whoa, whoa."{w}
note: 'oioi' -- the Bishop protests the Fighter dumping it on strangers.
Source spells kurotowa here, kurotoa elsewhere (DGN_NAME, wmap slice_07 row 558); same place -> 'Crotoa City Ruins'.

en:
"Mind you, it only seems to work
in the Crotoa City Ruins."{w}

"Right, right, it's safe as long as you just carry it.
Here, take it!"{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Strange Box Garden.{w}
note: See row 939.

en:
"Put it back where it was in the Crotoa City Ruins
and you can go inside. As for the spot... ...Sorry, I forgot."{w}

note: Repeat-talk variant of row 1006.

en: *  Desert Wind  *{0F}{w}
note: op096 with a closing {0F} but no {0E}, as in the source. 'sabaku no kaze' -- probably a title/inscription; what it names is not clear from the script.
Centred framed text: full-width padding lines -> ASCII spaces / empty lines (3-line box kept). See row 1009.

en: A plant has taken root here, enduring the dryness of the desert.{w}

A plant has taken root here, enduring the dryness of the desert.{w}As you reach out to take it,
you hear a bird cry out from somewhere.{w}
note: Ties to the cactus/bird story in wmap slice_17 row 1358 (birds eat desert-plant flesh for their voices).

en: Take it?
Something swooped down from the sky and attacked you!{w}

[Key Item]
Obtained Cactus Pulp.{w}
note: 'saboten no kaniku' -> 'Cactus Pulp' (wmap slice_17 row 1358 says 'the flesh of a plant'; 'pulp' reads better as an item name).
'kare (moshikuwa kanojo)' -- the narrator's deliberate he (or she) joke kept. Sentence spans a page break as in the source.
